# Auto-generated: capture-on-death. When an artifact-bearing character is slain
# in battle, 25% the treasure is seized by a war enemy, else destroyed. The
# dead wielder's country always loses the army modifier.

# scope:omni_art_dead_country set. $TREASURE$ = treasure key, $ARMY$ = army modifier.
omni_artifact_lose_treasure = {
	scope:omni_art_dead_country = { remove_country_modifier = $ARMY$ }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:omni_art_dead_country = { war = yes } }
		random_list = {
			25 = {
				scope:omni_art_dead_country = { random_countries_at_war_with = { save_scope_as = omni_art_captor } }
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:omni_art_captor }
					scope:omni_art_dead_country = { every_country_treasure = { limit = { exists = treasure:$TREASURE$ THIS = treasure:$TREASURE$ } transfer_treasure_to_country = scope:omni_art_captor } }
				}
				else = { scope:omni_art_dead_country = { every_country_treasure = { limit = { exists = treasure:$TREASURE$ THIS = treasure:$TREASURE$ } destroy_treasure = yes } } }
			}
			75 = { scope:omni_art_dead_country = { every_country_treasure = { limit = { exists = treasure:$TREASURE$ THIS = treasure:$TREASURE$ } destroy_treasure = yes } } }
		}
	}
}

# ROOT = dead character. Called from on_character_death only when slain in battle.
omni_artifact_on_death_capture = {
	if = { limit = { exists = country } country = { save_scope_as = omni_art_dead_country } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:omni_art_dead_country has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_Cyrogley_crown_of_eagalia } } omni_artifact_lose_treasure = { TREASURE = Cyrogley_crown_of_eagalia ARMY = item_artifact_Cyrogley_crown_of_eagalia_army } }
	else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:omni_art_dead_country has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_mother_warrior_mace } } omni_artifact_lose_treasure = { TREASURE = treasure_mother_warrior_mace ARMY = item_artifact_treasure_mother_warrior_mace_army } }
